title: On an affine space over a Noetherian base every quasi-coherent module is a filtered colimit of finitely presented modules

difficulty_reason: The lemma expresses every quasi-coherent module on an affine space over a Noetherian base as a filtered colimit of finitely presented modules (statement lines 2897-2903). The proof pulls back a filtered system of coherent modules approximating the pushforward, uses affineness (checked on an etale cover, where the statement is the classical one for schemes) to show that the counit is surjective, and then manufactures the colimit description from cokernels of maps between the approximating modules, checking that the indexing set of triples is directed. The construction of the directed system is the substance, so the claim is H2.
